positions.name: ProbeAssertsAutomaticReviewerEnrollment
positions.frame: what does this probe memory establish about the mechanism that enrolls a memory's creator as reviewer?
positions.why: src-1 states the decision that saving a memory automatically enrolls its creator as reviewer, and src-2 frames the probe memory's entire existence as instrumental to carrying that one assertion — both read the same direction: the artifact and its purpose collapse into a single verification of an automated, rule-based role assignment (the dimensional reads for both segments converge on authority-ranking/automated-role-assignment and the same flat, matter-of-fact technical register, supporting one coherent group rather than two separate claims).
